item.description: Background Myocardial ischemia is a dynamic, complex process characterized by hyperkalemia, acidosis, and ATP depletion. item.title: Quantification of 25-hydroxyvitamin D3 in dried blood spots as compared to plasma among Indian adults [version 2; peer review: 1 approved, 2 approved with reservations]
item.description: Background Vitamin D may play an important role in later-life physical and cognitive health. Vitamin D status is standardly assessed in serum and plasma; however, collection, transport, and storage costs make large epidemiologic studies challenging. We assessed the agreement of 25-hydroxyvitamin D3 (25(OH)D3) quantification from dried blood spots (DBS) as compared to standard plasma assessment among older Indian adults.
